ascendant.conjunction: You have a presence people react to before you have spoken, and you have been called intense since childhood.
ascendant.harmonious: You can be direct about difficult things without frightening anybody, which puts you in a great many confidences.
ascendant.square: You come across as guarded or forceful, and the reactions you provoke are stronger than the situation warranted.
ascendant.opposition: You meet powerful people whether you look for them or not, and the important relationships of your life have involved a struggle over who decides.

midheaven.conjunction: Your career carries real weight, and it has already been demolished and rebuilt at least once.
midheaven.harmonious: You accumulate influence quietly and are trusted with things that matter, without ever having campaigned for it.
midheaven.square: Power struggles follow you at work, and you have left at least one position rather than concede one.
midheaven.opposition: The upheavals in your public life have their roots at home, and you have rebuilt both at the same time more than once.
